create_word_embedding: create a WordEmbedding feature that extracts 300-dim spaCy word vectors for a given language
create_small_word_embedding: create a WordEmbeddingSmall feature that extracts 96-dim small spaCy word vectors for memory efficiency
create_pos_tagging: create a PartOfSpeech feature that returns a categorical POS index for a word using spaCy
create_bert_embedding: create a BertEmbedding feature that extracts 768-dim multilingual BERT contextual embeddings for a word
create_xlm_embedding: create an XlmEmbedding feature that extracts 1024-dim XLM-R raw or contextual embeddings for a word
